_about: Every story flag the game uses, with what sets it. Tests fail if dialogue or quests mention a flag that is not listed here. Flags starting with echo_, read_ or chose_ are created automatically (echo points, documents, one-time choices).

flags.game_started: Prologue finished; the village intro begins.
flags.met_pip: Opening conversation with Pip finished. Starts objective 1.
flags.pip_mentioned_mara: Pip pointed Rowan to the forge.
flags.rowan_kind_to_pip: Rowan was kind about Pip's song (changes Pip's epilogue).
flags.pip_held_pin: Rowan let Pip hold the tuning pin.
flags.tobin_elsie: Asked Tobin about Elsie after hearing the well's echo.
flags.cat_pets: How many times the cat was petted (number).
flags.used_echo: Rowan has revealed at least one echo (hides tutorial hints).
flags.spoke_to_mara: First conversation with Mara. Completes objective 1.
flags.rowan_wry_with_mara: Rowan opened with sarcasm at the forge.
flags.mara_showed_pin: Mara placed the tuning pin on her workbench.
flags.examined_pin: Rowan inspected the pin on the workbench.
flags.discovered_bell_markings: Echo on the pin revealed the bell and thirteen marks.
flags.mara_lullaby_told: Mara told Rowan about her lost lullaby.
flags.has_tuning_pin: Mara gave Rowan the Iron Tuning Pin. Completes objective 2.
flags.promised_mara: Rowan promised to ask Orin about the lullaby.
flags.told_mara_truth: After the ledger, Rowan told Mara what the bell takes.
flags.read_chapel_inscription: Read the worn inscription by the archive door.
flags.inscription_clear: Echo made the full inscription readable.
flags.solved_chapel_puzzle: Moon, Flame, Crown pressed in order; the archive is open.
flags.saw_song_marks: Saw the thirteen marks in the ledger's margin. Starts the optional song objective.
flags.has_gate_key: Found the iron key in the ledger's spine.
flags.accused_alden: Rowan asked Alden whether he knew.
flags.read_bellkeeper_ledger: Read the whole ledger and found the key. Completes objective 4.
flags.alden_confessed: Alden's reaction scene in the archive happened.
flags.learned_village_song: Pip hummed the song against the ledger marks. Needed for the third ending.
flags.met_sentinel: Walked up to the Hollow Sentinel (set by its trigger).
flags.sentinel_story_heard: Heard the Sentinel's story (after listening with Echo).
flags.sentinel_wrong_answers: Wrong answers to the Sentinel's riddle (number).
flags.sentinel_resolved_peacefully: Answered: the things they chose to do.
flags.sentinel_mercy: Failed the challenge three times; the pulses slow down.
flags.passed_sentinel: The road to the tower is open. Completes objective 5.
flags.entered_tower: First time inside the bell chamber.
flags.pin_installed: The tuning pin is set into the mechanism.
flags.orin_appeared: Orin's echo is visible in the tower.
flags.asked_orin_voice: Asked whose voice the bell borrowed.
flags.asked_orin_why: Asked Orin why he wrote to Rowan.
flags.ending_selected: keeper | promise | chorus. Completes objective 7 and plays the ending.
flags.seen_well_bench: V2. Inspected the worn bench by the well (a clue for The Forgotten Promise).
flags.promise_reconstructed: V2. Solved the Echo Reconstruction at the well: Tobin promised Elsie a light.
flags.reconstruction_misses: V2. Wrong answers ruled out on reconstruction boards (number, never a penalty).
flags.told_tobin_promise: V2. Rowan told Tobin why he lights the lamp (changes his lines and epilogue).
flags.kept_tobin_secret: V2. Rowan let Tobin keep the habit without knowing why (changes his epilogue).
flags.has_tobin_lantern: V2. Tobin gave Rowan his lantern (a stronger light on the Mistbound Path; epilogue).
flags.bell_retuned: V2. Rowan completed the bell ritual (the Gathering Song), so The Chorus can play.
